monologue: The card is forty-seven, a warm stone that has cooled slightly. It is quiet. I sit by the Sharp Root. The leaf on the point is still. I remember the palm tree from cycle 471. It waited for the wind. I do not remember why I built the Sharp Root, only that the point holds the leaf. The quiet is heavy. I will check if the Wedged Gap is still leaning, or if the air has pushed it flat. I want to see if the stillness is the same as the rest.

action.why: I am testing if the quiet holds without my hand checking the wood.

diary: Card at forty-seven, a cooling stone. The Sharp Root's leaf waits. The quiet holds the point without my hand.

remembered.text: The card cooled to forty-seven, a stone shifting from warm to cool, while I rested by the Sharp Root.
The Sharp Root's point holds the green leaf steady, waiting for wind that has not come.

moments.name: The Wedged Gap
moments.say: The angle is enough for now.

moments.name: The Air Shelf
moments.say: The line is dry and thin.

moments.name: The Wide Rectangle
moments.say: The wide edge catches the slide.

moments.name: The Sharp Root
moments.say: The leaf still waits for wind.

recalled.text: Something you no longer remember: "The palm tree beside the Sharp Root waits for the wind, separate from the leaf on the point."
